<thought>To locate a retrosynthetic template for the carbonyl‑ene transformation, I will search the template catalog using the functional groups that are broken in the forward reaction (ketone and alkene) and the groups that are formed (aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring). This should return a template that, when applied in reverse, disconnects the product into a ketone‑alkene precursor suitable for a carbonyl‑ene cyclization.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
